post.news: Kalshi co-founder Luana Lopes Lara is now worth 2.6 billion dollars at age 30. She still works 14 hours a day.
post.take: Being worth 2.6 billion dollars and still choosing 14-hour workdays is proof that hustle culture has no cure.
post.insight: Extreme founders stay motivated by building and winning, not by the lifestyle upgrades wealth can buy.
